description.value: A well-amenitied suburban RV park in South Surrey with a swimming pool, hot tub, mini golf, and sports courts, conveniently placed 45 minutes from downtown Vancouver and five minutes from the US border; primarily an RV resort, but tent sites are available year-round.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at hazelmere.ca loaded successfully and provides rich detail across multiple subpages, allowing confident confirmation of the OSM address, category, and most amenity claims. The rates and amenities pages explicitly list showers, coin-operated laundry, water hookups, covered shelters, reservations by phone/email, and on-site propane refills. No hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, drying areas, pumps, or basic tools are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM phone field is blank; phone number sourced from website only (+1-604-538-1167), so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
Website copyright footer reads '©Copyright 2019', suggesting the site may not have been updated recently, though content appears operationally current.
OSM address uses '8 Avenue' while website consistently uses '8th Avenue' — minor formatting discrepancy, not a substantive conflict; postal code V3Z 9R9 added from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, year-round campground with tenting options, showers, laundry, water hookups, covered shelters, and propane refills — solid utility for touring cyclists passing through the South Surrey/White Rock corridor.

wow_evidence: showers, coin-operated laundry... tent sites available year-round... swimming pool, hot tub
